description: Add on-chain verification via Helius RPC - dev holding %, mint/freeze authority checks, top10 concentration, safe score calculation, and integrate into scanner pipeline.
steps: Create memescanner/onchain.py with OnchainAnalyzer class using Helius RPC
Integrate on-chain check into scanner.py after rug filter and before P(2x) filter
Add rejection criteria: dev_holding > 30% or mint_authority not revoked
Update rug estimation with safe_score adjustment
Add on-chain info line to Telegram message format
Add rate limit protection: max 5 on-chain checks per cycle
acceptance_criteria: OnchainAnalyzer.check_token returns dev_holding_pct, top10_concentration_pct, mint_authority_revoked, freeze_authority_revoked, lp_locked, safe_score, flags
Safe score calculation follows exact rubric (start at 50, modifiers as specified)
Uses httpx async with 8s timeout and 0.3s delay between RPC calls
Partial data returned on RPC failure
Scanner rejects tokens with mint_authority NOT revoked
Safe score adjusts rug %: >70 reduces by 10pp, <30 increases by 15pp
Telegram message includes on-chain line between rug % and X account line
Maximum 5 on-chain checks per scan cycle
On-chain errors skip check but still allow alert without on-chain line
